description:
You are a flight instructor planning a multi-day VFR scenic tour of the Pacific Northwest for a group of student pilots. The tour must cover major airports from Seattle south through Portland, Eugene, and Medford to give students exposure to different controlled and uncontrolled airspace.

Your task: switch Avare to VFR Sectional chart display (the standard for VFR training), then build and save a flight plan named PNW_TOUR that includes all of the following airports as waypoints: KSEA (Seattle-Tacoma), KPDX (Portland), KEUG (Eugene), and KMFR (Medford/Rogue Valley). The plan must be saved with the filename PNW_TOUR.csv.
